notes:
Population uses the 2025 Thai census provincial totals and WorldPop's modeled 2025 distribution in 100 m cells, adjusted before cropping. These are not measured census counts per grid cell. Residents are grouped into accessible neighborhood points, without measured dwelling counts. The residential-placement selection is an approximate classification. Within each province, population follows WorldPop’s uneven modeled 100 m distribution, adjusted to census totals; it is not spread uniformly across the province.

Jobs combine 2025 DIW factory counts, December 2024 SSO provincial benchmarks, and Bangkok's 2022 BMA/DLPW district employee shares. Factory counts are assumed to overlap SSO counts and are subtracted when forming a relative guide for other jobs. OSM and Overture floor area and workplace categories guide local placement. Remaining jobs are normalized to modeled internal commuters; cropped provinces outside Bangkok use population-share estimates.

Commute flows use a road-network gravity model balanced to these assigned totals, without observed OD calibration. OSRM estimates driving routes and times; no measured congestion adjustment is applied.

Airport demand uses AOT FY2025 passenger totals with estimated ground-access shares. Matched BMA schools and Chulalongkorn use 2025 enrollment with attendance assumptions. Other destination attendance remains estimated.
